dedupe_keys.name: high resolution gridded inventory of coal mine methane emissions for india and australia

description: This dataset gives gridded coal mine methane emissions for India and Australia for the year 2018 at a resolution of 0.1 by 0.1 degrees, in tonnes per grid cell per year. It was produced by Pankaj Sadavarte, Sudhanshu Pandey, Joannes Maasakkers, Hugo Denier van der Gon, Sander Houweling and Ilse Aben as a bottom-up inventory of coal mine methane. The record, published on 22 February 2022, contains two CSV files (Australia about 4.6 MB, India about 1.8 MB) and is a free Zenodo download under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: it covers a single year and two countries, the estimation method is documented in the associated publication, not the record, and emissions are modelled from mine activity data. For simulation it locates coal mining activity and its emission intensity, supporting environmental impact scenarios and exposure analyses around coal mining regions and their rail and port corridors. Related catalogue records include China's coal methane emissions inventory for 2011 to 2019 and the Global Coal Mine Tracker.
